text:
ara (PM): quick GA-playbook sync: single-page checklist for SLA, monitoring, support runbooks, pricing fallback, and Dedicated handoff. keep it copy-ready for sales.
pete (SRE): SLOs: p95 <= 150ms, p99 <= 400ms, uptime >= 99.95%. will add burn-rate alert and an error-budget exhaustion flow.
mina (ProdOps): confirm we have a tested fallback path (quantized model + region spill). scheduling a 30m failover run tomorrow 07:00 PT.
zoe (Docs): I'll author the one-pager + templates: SLA blurb, outage email, and handoff checklist. need sample payload sizes.
sam (FinOps): pricing fallbacks: option A burst credits + surcharge, option B throttled tier with discount. will attach simple numbers and example invoice text.
nora (Support): runbook owners: model-quality -> research oncall; infra latency -> infra oncall; billing -> finops. Ill draft triage steps and canned replies.
ops-bot: Deploy: prod-serving/v1.9 rolled out 2024-07-10T14:01Z.
ara (PM): owners + deadlines: SRE alerts + burn-rate doc (pete) - EOD; ProdOps failover artifacts (mina) - tomorrow AM; Docs one-pager (zoe) - EOD; FinOps pricing sheet (sam) - EOD; Support dry-run (nora) - next week.
pete (SRE): I'll push alert rules: p95>150ms for 5m, burn_rate>2 for 1h, plus synthetic that mixes 30/70 short/long sequences for 72h.
mina (ProdOps): I'll post failover results and a tiny how-to so oncall can reproduce.
zoe (Docs): will open PR /docs/launch/ga-playbook.md with templates for SLA exception and rollback criteria.
sam (FinOps): adding auto-throttle clause: sustained >3x baseline for 15m triggers throttle unless burst credits elected.
nora (Support): scheduling 30m dry-run with oncall; will circulate calendar and test canned comms.
ara (PM): perfect. reconvene tomorrow 09:30 PT for final go/no-go. thanks everyone :white_check_mark:
